mapper.update: /*insertMasterWmGiMultiReleaseTransPopList*/ INSERT INTO WMSIVDT ( WAREHOUSE_CODE, SELLER, INV_NO, INV_SEQ, BUYER, STATUS, SEND_DATE, SEND_TIME, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CONFIRM_DATE, CONFIRM_TIME, BUYER_ITEM_NO, SELLER_ITEM_NO, STDCATLG_ID, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, PROCESS_TYPE, PO_QTY, GR_QTY, INV_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, LIST_PRICE, UNIT_AMT, LIST_AMT, ORIGIN_CODE, MAKER_NAME, AGENT, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, S_INV_NO, S_INV_SEQ, REF_PR_NO, PR_NO, PR_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, DELY_TO_LOCATION, PO_DATE, GR_DATE, INV_DATE, DELIVERY_QTY, DELIVERY_DATE, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_USER_ID, DELIVERY_USER_ID, LEGACY_IV_SERIAL, DELIVERY_COMPANY, DELIVERY_NO, CMS_CATLG_ID, SCHEDULED_DATE, CAR_ID, CAR_NO, CAR_PERSON_NAME, CAR_PERSON_TEL, BOX_QTY, DELIVERY_PERSON, TAG_NO ) ( SELECT #{st_warehouse_code} AS WAREHOUSE_CODE, IVDT.SELLER AS SELLER, #{INVK_NO} AS INV_NO, ( SELECT TO_CHAR(NVL(TO_NUMBER(MAX(WD.INV_SEQ)),0)+1,'FM000000') FROM WMSIVDT WD WHERE WD.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND WD.INV_NO = #{INVK_NO} ) AS INV_SEQ, IVDT.BUYER AS BUYER, 'C' AS STATUS, '' AS SEND_DATE, '' AS SEND_TIME, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS ADD_TIME, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CHANGE_DATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS CHANGE_TIME, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CONFIRM_DATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS CONFIRM_TIME, IVDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, IVDT.SELLER_ITEM_NO AS SELLER_ITEM_NO, PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID, PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, PODT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, PODT.PROCESS_TYPE AS PROCESS_TYPE, PODT.ITEM_QTY AS PO_QTY, IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY AS GR_QTY, #{WMS_GW_QTY} AS INV_QTY, PODT.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(PODT.AGENT_PRICE, 0) AS LIST_PRICE, ROUND(#{WMS_GW_QTY} * NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0)) AS UNIT_AMT, ROUND(#{WMS_GW_QTY} * NVL(PODT.AGENT_PRICE,0)) AS LIST_AMT, PODT.ORIGIN_CODE AS ORIGIN_CODE, PODT.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, POHD.AGENT AS AGENT, PODT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, IVDT.INV_NO AS S_INV_NO, IVDT.INV_SEQ AS S_INV_SEQ, PODT.REF_PR_NO AS REF_PR_NO, PODT.PR_NO AS PR_NO, PODT.PR_SEQ AS PR_SEQ, PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, PODT.DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_DATE, IVDT.WMS_GR_DATE AS GR_DATE, REPLACE(#{st_inv_date}, '/', '') AS INV_DATE, 0 AS DELIVERY_QTY, '' AS DELIVERY_DATE, #{st_user_id} AS ADD_USER_ID, #{st_user_id} AS CHANGE_USER_ID, '' AS DELIVERY_USER_ID, #{LEGACY_IV_SERIAL}, '' AS DELIVERY_COMPANY, '' AS DELIVERY_NO, PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS CMS_CATELG_ID, NVL(REPLACE(#{st_scheduled_date}, '/', ''), F_GET_WORKINGDAY(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), 1)) AS SCHEDULED_DATE, #{CAR_ID}, #{CAR_NO}, #{CAR_PERSON_NAME}, #{CAR_PERSON_TEL}, #{BOX_QTY}, '' DELIVERY_PERSON, IVDT.TAG_NO AS TAG_NO FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMIVDT IVDT, ICOMIVHD IVHD WHERE PODT.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND PODT.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND PODT.PO_SEQ = #{PO_SEQ} AND IVDT.INV_NO = #{INV_NO} AND IVDT.INV_SEQ = #{INV_SEQ} AND PODT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND IVDT.SELLER = IVHD.SELLER AND IVDT.BUYER = IVHD.BUYER AND IVDT.INV_NO = IVHD.INV_NO AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVHD.STATUS <> 'D' )
